question: A rectangular field has an area of $800$ m$^2$. Find its dimensions for which the length of fencing required around it is minimum. Also determine the minimum perimeter.
explanation:
Area constraint
Let the breadth be $x$ m. Then the length is $\frac{800}{x}$ m.
Perimeter function
$$P(x)=2\left(x+\frac{800}{x}\right)=2x+\frac{1600}{x}$$
Stationary condition
$$P'(x)=2-\frac{1600}{x^2}$$
Setting $P'(x)=0$ gives
$$x^2=800\Rightarrow x=20\sqrt{2}$$
Minimum verification
$$P''(x)=\frac{3200}{x^3}>0$$
Thus, the perimeter is minimum. The length is also $20\sqrt{2}$ m.
Minimum perimeter
$$P_{\min}=4(20\sqrt{2})=80\sqrt{2}\text{ m}$$
Conclusion
The field must be a square of side $20\sqrt{2}$ m.

options.A: Dimensions $20$ m by $40$ m; minimum perimeter $120$ m
options.B: Dimensions $10\sqrt{8}$ m by $20\sqrt{2}$ m; minimum perimeter $60\sqrt{2}$ m
options.C: Dimensions $40\sqrt{2}$ m by $10\sqrt{2}$ m; minimum perimeter $100\sqrt{2}$ m
options.D: Dimensions $20\sqrt{2}$ m by $20\sqrt{2}$ m; minimum perimeter $80\sqrt{2}$ m
